title: The crawlable public Space page published a name-only LocalBusiness node, while the member layout passed the full NAP, hours, links and rating to the same builder

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, two independent finders: seo-jsonld and seo-local). app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/page.tsx, the self-canonical URL in the sitemap, called spaceSchema with slug, type, name, tagline and logo only; app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/layout.tsx, which a signed-out crawler never reaches, passed telephone, address (street + spaces.city), sameAs (website + socials), priceRange, openingHours and aggregateRating. So the one LocalBusiness node Google reads for a Space carried none of the facts local search and answer engines rank on. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the public page reads the same sources (readProfileData on preferences, pure; parseOpeningHours, pure; getSpaceReviews, a service-role read of Space data that fails to no rating) and passes the same fields. No cookie read enters the route, so its ISR holds.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/page.tsx","utf8");const i=s.indexOf("spaceSchema({");const b=i<0?"":s.slice(i,i+1600);const miss=["telephone:","addressLocality","sameAs:","openingHours: parseOpeningHours(","aggregateRating"].filter((k)=>!b.includes(k));if(miss.length){console.error("SCAN-663: the crawlable /spaces/<slug> page emits a LocalBusiness node without "+miss.join(", ")+": a name-only stub where the member layout passes the full NAP, hours, links and rating to the same builder, so local search and answer engines never see the business facts.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
